name: SynapDome Burp Suite Legacy Plugin
purpose: Capture authorized Burp proxy, sitemap, scanner, and request evidence, upload it to SynapDome, then submit a signed artifact URL to the Red Team Agent Node for web/API follow-up scans.
securityRequirements: Only capture traffic from engagements with written authorization.
Do not send cookies, bearer tokens, or session secrets unless the SynapDome engagement explicitly requires authenticated testing.
Upload raw artifacts to SynapDome storage first; pass only signed fetch URLs or normalized target URLs to the Red Team Agent Node.
